description: This file defines an abstract class 'reqMgrSystemInterface' that serves as a base for connecting and interacting with requirement management system interfaces within the TestLink project. It includes methods for configuration, connection management, and data retrieval related to projects, baselines, and requirements.

classes.name: reqMgrSystemInterface
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a template for connecting to requirement management systems and retrieving related data. Intended to be extended with specific implementation details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the configuration and attempts to establish a connection.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML configuration string.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface PHP configuration value.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the system is connected.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the requirement management server.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the connection to the server.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves the list of projects from the server.

methods.name: getBaselines
methods.description: Retrieves baselines for a specified project.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Retrieves requirements for a given project and baseline.
